fact: Decreto n.º 10/2025, published in Boletim Oficial n.º 12 (4.º Suplemento) of 28 March 2025 after Council of Ministers approval on 13 March, approves the ENTD.GW 2025-2030 as an integral annex, which calls itself the country's most comprehensive digital strategy.
The full text of the ENTD.GW is public as the annex to the gazetted decree, and its stated period is 2025-2030.

The ENTD.GW sets 55 interventions under six strategic objectives, each with a stated start, end and duration in months (for example interventions 46 to 51 between January 2025 and June 2026); the passages read state no cost for them.
The full text is public as the annex to the gazetted decree.

InforMEA records Decree No. 10/2025 of 28 March 2025 as approving the National Strategy for Digital Transformation for Guinea-Bissau 2025-2030 (ENTD.GW), aimed at a capable state energising the economy and an inclusive society.
InforMEA's summary says the ENTD.GW breaks its vision into six strategic objectives and 55 interventions indexed to them, with no cost stated.

UNU-EGOV reports that the ENTD.GW was launched on 29 January 2025 with the Prime Minister and the Minister of Transport, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, and that on 31 January the Prime Minister was briefed on its approval by the Council of Ministers and the decree needed for it.
